Name Generator

BoobaStudio's Name Generator creates AI-powered names for characters, places, items, and more. Generate names that fit your game system, setting, and cultural context.

Overview

The Name Generator uses AI to produce thematically appropriate names. It considers your game system (fantasy, sci-fi, modern) and any specific context you provide to generate fitting names.

How It Works

  • Open the Name Generator — from the BoobaStudio menu or welcome screen
  • Choose a Category — character, place, tavern, organization, etc.
  • Set Context — optionally specify culture, genre, or style
  • Generate — the AI produces a list of name suggestions
  • Pick and Use — select a name and apply it to your document

Accessing the Name Generator

From the BoobaStudio menu

  • Open the BoobaStudio radial menu
  • Select the Name Generator option

From the Welcome Screen

  • Open the BoobaStudio welcome screen
  • Click the Name Generator card

From Document Creation

When creating new actors or items through BoobaStudio, name generation is integrated into the creation flow.

Name Categories

The generator can create names for:

  • Characters — NPCs, PCs, villains, henchmen
  • Places — towns, cities, dungeons, taverns, shops
  • Organizations — guilds, factions, cults, noble houses
  • Items — magical weapons, artifacts, potions, spell names
  • Creatures — monsters, beasts, familiars

Customization

Cultural Context

Specify a cultural influence for the generated names:

  • Medieval European, Norse, Celtic, Arabic, Asian
  • Elvish, Dwarven, Orcish (for fantasy settings)
  • Corporate, Military, Scientific (for modern/sci-fi settings)

Style Options

  • Simple — short, easy-to-pronounce names
  • Complex — longer, more elaborate names
  • Exotic — unusual, otherworldly-sounding names

Tips

  • Generate in batches — create a list of names to keep on hand during sessions
  • Mix and match — combine generated first names with different surnames
  • Use for improvisation — when players ask an NPC's name, have a list ready
  • System-aware — BoobaStudio adapts names to your game system automatically

Requirements

  • BoobaStudio module installed and configured
  • A configured provider (Module Settings → BoobaStudio)
  • Low provider cost per generation
